title: Shoemaker-Levy 9 breaks apart and strikes Jupiter

tellings.quote: So in I think the second week of July 1994, those 21 pieces impacted Jupiter.
Shoemaker Levy 9 which collided with Jupiter in 1994.
tellings.difference: Does not mention the 21 fragments or the July date.
tellings.link_reason: The same 1994 impact of Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 on Jupiter.

plain: In 1994 a body called Shoemaker-Levy 9 broke apart and its pieces smashed into the planet Jupiter. A researcher named Randall Carlson tells Michels that 21 pieces hit Jupiter, he thinks in the second week of July 1994. Michels, on an earlier episode with the writer Graham Hancock, says himself that Shoemaker-Levy 9 collided with Jupiter in 1994, without giving the number of pieces or the month. It is told as proof that impacts from space really do happen in our own solar system.
